reviews.review_title: A Complete Waste of Time and Money
reviews.review_comment: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content. Full content visible, double tap to read brief content. I purchased this laptop expecting a brand-new unit. The laptop itself worked properly and the hardware appeared to be in good condition, but after checking the product information, I found that the HP factory warranty had already started on 19 September 2025, while I purchased the laptop much later. I also found that Windows had been freshly installed on 8 August 2026. The HP serial number was consistent across the system, and the SSD showed as healthy, but the earlier warranty start date raised concerns about whether this was actually a brand-new unit or a previously sold/open-box/refurbished unit. If a product is listed and sold as new, I expect the warranty to correspond reasonably closely with my purchase, or at least for any previous warranty activation to be clearly disclosed. I have decided to return the laptop because of this uncertainty. Buyers should check the HP warranty status and serial number immediately after receiving the laptop, especially when purchasing an expensive electronic device.
